title: Engineering - Internal AI Transformation
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

The role / impact
As an Internal AI Engineer at ElevenLabs, you'll be embedded at the frontier of how we scale - acting as a forward-deployed engineer across our GTM, Operations, and Finance teams. You won't just build tools; you'll co-design and ship agentic AI workflows that eliminate manual toil and fundamentally reshape how our people operate.

Your impact goes beyond the code. You'll own high-stakes automations from discovery to production, acting as a technical partner to internal teams. The patterns, guardrails, and tooling you define will become the blueprint other teams reach for - the standard for how ElevenLabs harnesses AI safely and at speed.

The team / how we work
You'll join a lean, high-velocity team with a shared obsession: turning broken, manual processes into elegant automated systems. We move fast through rapid experimentation, work closely with operators and business owners to uncover the real problem, and ship pragmatic solutions without waiting for perfect specs.

What you'll actually be working on

- Designing and iterating on AI agents and workflow orchestrations using tools like ElevenAgents, Claude, and n8n.

- Integrating AI systems with our core business stack - Salesforce, Slack, Ashby, and more

- Building reusable automation services, patterns and shared templates that multiply the output of every team you t

title: Engineering Manager, Cloud Infrastructure
description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit enables people to build software with AI. The infrastructure underneath that experience must make it straightforward to launch services, isolate workloads, and run reliable systems at scale.

We're hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead Cloud Infrastructure: the shared infrastructure as code (IaC), networking, storage, compute, and service mesh platforms that Replit's product and platform teams depend on. You'll lead and grow an existing engineering team building and operating these foundations, including Kubernetes, shared edge networking, service mesh and workload identity.

This is a platform-building role with production accountability. You should be comfortable going deep on a design or incident while developing a team that does not depend on you for every decision.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the cloud-platform roadmap. Lead the team's IaC, networking, storage, compute, and service mesh platforms. Translate product, platform, reliability, and security needs into sequenced outcomes, balancing foundational investment, lifecycle work, and delivery commitments against the team's capacity.

- Make infrastructure repeatable and self-service. Build maintained IaC interfaces for services, cells, connectivity, identities, and shared resources. Enable internal customer teams to provision infrastructure without bespoke coordination or dependence on individual experts.

- Operate what the team builds. Own platform availability, upgrades, isolation, recovery, and incident remediation. Maintain clear SLOs, sustainable on-call coverage, and primary and backup owners for critical systems.

- Stay technically engaged. Review designs and production changes, debug difficult failure modes, and use AI coding tools-including Replit-to prototype and automate. Apply rigorous review and verification to AI-generated infrastructure changes.

- Build and grow a high-ownership engineering team. Coach engineers, develop technical leaders, set clear expectations, manage performance, and hire against agreed needs. Delegate meaningful ownership as the team grows.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Demonstrated engineering management. You have led and developed engineers, made prioritization and performance decisions, hired thoughtfully, and delivered through a team-not only acted as its strongest individual contributor.

- Software-oriented infrastructure depth. You have built and operated cloud platforms or distributed systems and can reason across infrastructure code, Kubernetes, networking, service identity, and stateful dependencies.

- Safe-change and production judgment. You have owned consequential migrations and incidents, can explain failure modes and rollback limits, and know when simplifying a system is better than adding another platform.

- Platform-product and engineering judgment. You understand internal customers, create interfaces other teams adopt, and make clear tradeoffs among reliability, developer autonomy, engineering effort, and workload efficiency.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with multi-tenant, cellular, regional, or dedicated enterprise infrastructure.

- Familiarity with GCP/GKE, Terraform or similar IaC systems, Cloudflare, Envoy/Istio, SPIFFE/SPIRE, and managed data services.

- Experience with large-fleet rightsizing, infrastructure consolidation, or migrating CI compute without disrupting developer workflows.

- A track record using AI tools to increase engineering output while preserving production safeguards.

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

title: SAP Basis Consultant and Security Consultant (8 Month)

title: Principal Software Engineer - IBM i (AS/400) Connectivity
description:
OUR MISSION
At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.

 

ABOUT US
Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric-with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle-Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.

 

CORE VALUES
One Team. One Redwood
Make Your Own Weather
Obsess over Customer Success
Work the Problem
Be Curious
Own the Outcome
Respect Each Other

 

YOUR IMPACT

As a Software Engineer - Principal, IBM i (AS/400) Connectivity, you will help build a new connectivity agent that extends Redwood RunMyJobs (RMJ) natively onto IBM i (AS/400), enabling Redwood to support some of the largest enterprise automation environments in the market. You will join a small, senior team building this capability largely from first principles, validating assumptions on live IBM i partitions and making architectural decisions where modern documentation may be limited. This position is open across levels from Software Engineer to Principal as we build out the team.

• Design, develop, test, and maintain native software supporting connectivity and integration with IBM i (AS/400) environments.

• Build native job submission and monitoring, spool file and message/data queue handling, and CL/RPG program invocation capabilities.

• Integrate IBM i functionality with the Redwood platform through clean, versioned extension points using native host server APIs and/or IBM Toolbox for Java (JTOpen/jt400).

• Integrate security and per-user authorization using IBM i user profiles and authority concepts while extending Redwood’s existing identity and credential management capabilities.

• Troubleshoot complex system-level issues across IBM i, Unix, and Java environments.

• Improve the reliability, performance, security, and scalability of Redwood’s IBM i solutions.

• Partner with product managers, architects, and engineers to translate customer requirements into effective technical solutions.

• Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, testing, and release planning.

• Leverage agentic AI to accelerate implementation, testing, and documentation while independently verifying correctness against authoritative IBM i references.

• Document connector behavior and platform prerequisites for field and support teams.

• Contribute to team success through clear communication, shared responsibility for quality, and accountable ownership of goals and delivery commitments in a fast-paced, iterative agile environment.

 

YOUR EXPERIENCE

• 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong Java 8+ skills.

• Hands-on IBM i (AS/400) integration experience, including CL, native job/spool/queue APIs, IBM Toolbox for Java (JTOpen/jt400), and DB2 for i.

• Working proficiency in C, including ILE C on IBM i.

• Experience integrating with vendor host-server or RPC-style APIs over TCP/IP, including connection lifecycle management and error handling.

• Strong concurrency and multithreading skills, with experience building resilient, long-running monitoring components such as job polling and spool/file event detection.

• Ability to work effectively from primary technical sources, including IBM i host-server and API references, rather than relying solely on tutorials or unverified AI-generated output.

• Experience with modern DevOps practices and technologies, including Git, CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes.

title: Principal Brand Designer
description:

At OLX , Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.

What you'll own

Define the future of OLX ’s Group's brand ecosystem

Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

title: HVAC Career Coach
description:
Part-Time HVAC Career Coach
(Flexible, Paid Workshops + Upside)
About CourseCareers

CourseCareers is an online education platform that helps people launch new careers without a college degree or prior experience .
We work with industry professionals to create job-focused courses that teach practical, employer-aligned skills in technology, business, and the skilled trades. Our students are career changers looking for realistic, entry-level opportunities - and coaching helps bridge the gap between coursework and landing the job.
About the Role
We’re looking for a part-time HVAC Career Coach to support students through live workshops and optional 1:1 coaching.
This is not a traditional employment role and not a guaranteed-income position . It’s a flexible, paid opportunity best suited for experienced HVAC technicians who enjoy mentoring, teaching, and helping others break into the trade - with upside if students choose to work with you.
How This Role Actually Works

• You host a live, one-hour workshop (seminar-style) for students

• You are paid $50 per workshop , plus any private coaching business you acquire

• You may receive exclusive coaching opportunities based on performance and engagement

• Workshops are used to provide value, answer questions, and showcase your real-world experience

• If students choose to book you for 1:1 coaching, you keep the coaching revenue

• You set your own availability and working hours

There is no requirement to convert students - workshops are paid regardless - but conversion is where the upside comes from.
Responsibilities

• Host a live, one-hour workshop on a monthly basis

• Answer student questions about HVAC careers and the job search

• Share real-world insight into what entry-level HVAC roles, apprenticeships, and certifications actually look like

• Provide optional 1:1 coaching to students who request it

What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years of professional HVAC experience (residential, commercial, or industrial)

• Familiarity with entry-level roles, apprenticeships, and certification pathways (EPA 608, etc.)

• Interest in mentoring and helping career changers enter the trades

• Strong communication and teaching ability

• Availability at least three evenings per week , ideally Tuesday-Thursday

• Self-starter mindset - comfortable leading workshops independently

Ideal Fit
This role is a great fit if you:

• Enjoy teaching and mentoring

• Want flexible, side income

• Like the idea of being paid to teach - with optional upside

• Don’t need guaranteed hours or full-time income

Compensation

• $50 per one-hour workshop (One per month guaranteed)

title: Patient Coordinator
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:
The Organ Health Patient Coordinator (PC) is the primary point of contact and dedicated advocate for patients undergoing organ health genetic testing. This role sits at the heart of Natera's mission - ensuring that every patient is supported, informed, and guided with care through each step of their testing journey. This position will be focused on growing the relationship between Natera and its patients to ensure timely management of testing.  Organ Health patients may require a single test or ongoing, long-term monitoring - in either case, the relationships PCs build are essential, whether that means earning the trust of a new patient to complete their first draw or maintaining continuity with patients throughout a recurring testing journey. A natural drive to overcome objections and convert hesitant patients into confident ones is key to growing the business and ensuring no patient is left behind.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Serve as the patient's dedicated advocate and single point of contact for all things related to their Organ Health testing experience.

• Assess the needs of patients with a focus on customer support, coordination of logistics, and problem solving.

• Set accurate expectations around sample collection scheduling, turnaround time, billing, and next steps to ensure patients feel informed and confident.

• Respond to patient-generated marketing leads and conduct outbound outreach for applicable patient identification and monitoring programs.

• Appropriately triage and escalate complex issues to cross-functional partners including the MP Team, Organ Health Specialists (OHS/Sales), Territory Managers, Customer Experience, and Billing Teams.

• Participate in rotating weekend on-call coverage to ensure urgent patient needs are addressed in a timely manner.

• Maintain and support a service-oriented relationship with patients

• Ensure all data and analysis requests from different parts of the organization are addressed in a timely manner.

• Identify, nurture and grow patient relationships in order to influence and schedule ongoing testing.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

• This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and has access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job.

• Adhere strictly to HIPAA regulations, including verifying patient identity on every interaction conducted.

• Employees must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.

• Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Minimum of 2 years of Call Center experience in an inbound and outbound capacity, patient services, or healthcare customer support role.

• Minimum of 2 years of sales experience 

• Background in medical or biological sciences preferred

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Genuine empathy and compassion; Strong active listening and rapport-building skills with the ability to handle emotionally complex conversations professionally.

• Ability to think strategically as well as execute tactically

• Emphasis on competitive analysis and team first attitude.

• Ability to relate and educate our technology to potential patients

• Comfortable navigating multiple systems and tools simultaneously.

• Self-motivation, with the desire and capacity to work both independently and collaboratively

• Must act with a sense of urgency

• Excellent organizational and communication skills (written and verbal)

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer, 3D Geometric Vision
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Teams

The Model Foundations team builds the geometric vision and 3D foundation models that underpin Wayve's autonomous driving systems, working at the intersection of large-scale deep learning, geometric computer vision, and real-world robotics to develop models that learn 3D structure and dynamics from fleet-scale sensor data.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Principal Engineer on the Model Foundations team, you will be a hands-on technical leader. You'll set direction for geometric vision, prototype and train new model architectures, build the data and supervision needed to scale them, and take successful ideas through to deployment on real vehicles.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Design and train 3D foundation models and world models using large-scale driving data.

- Develop model architectures for 3D perception, geometric reasoning, reconstruction, and world modeling across space and time.

- Build scalable data generation and auto-labeling pipelines that produce high-quality geometric supervision from large volumes of sensor data.

- Develop and scale offline SLAM and 3D reconstruction systems and pipelines, using large-scale sensor data to recover accurate trajectories, scene geometry, calibration signals, and geometric supervision for model training and evaluation.

- Develop and apply techniques in multi-view geometry, neural rendering, NeRFs, Gaussian Splatting, implicit 3D representations, and feedforward 3D modeling.

- Explore geometry-aware tokenization and representation learning, including efficient ways to encode and fuse information across cameras, viewpoints, time, and sensing modalities.

- Develop foundation vision models that make effective use of camera, radar, LiDAR, and other sensor data for learning rich representations of the physical world.

- Explore video and generative modeling approaches for learning scene structure, dynamics, and future evolution from driving data.

- Train and evaluate models at scale on distributed compute, rapidly iterating on architectures, objectives, data, and training recipes.

- Develop automated evaluation and ground-truth systems for measuring geometric consistency, reconstruction quality, 3D understanding, and downstream driving performance.

- Optimize and deploy models into production autonomous-driving systems, working across model architecture, inference, and onboard constraints.

- Set technical direction for geometric vision at Wayve and work closely with researchers and engineers across foundation models, perception, simulation, data, sensing, and deployment.

 

🙌 You should apply if

Essential

- You have deep expertise in 3D computer vision, geometric vision, or 3D machine learning, with experience in areas such as multi-view geometry, neural rendering, reconstruction, implicit representations, or world modeling.

- You have strong experience designing, training, and evaluating modern deep-learning models at scale, using PyTorch or a comparable framework.

- You have strong mathematical and technical foundations in geometry, linear algebra, probability, optimization, and 3D transformations, combined with excellent software engineering skills in Python and C++.

- You have a track record of taking difficult research problems from idea to working system, including building large-scale data, training, evaluation, or deployment pipelines.

- You bring principal-level technical leadership: the ability to identify high-leverage problems, set research and engineering direction, make strong architectural decisions, and raise the technical bar across teams.

Desirable

- 3D and geometric vision: multi-view geometry, dense 3D reco

title: Kfz-Meister gesucht – vielleicht ist es Zeit für eine Werkstatt, die wirklich zu dir passt.
description: Kfz-Meister gesucht - vielleicht ist es Zeit für eine Werkstatt, die wirklich zu dir passt. Wir sind autoteam augsburg , eine inhabergeführte Kfz-Meisterwerkstatt in Augsburg-Kriegshaber. Bei uns geht es nicht darum, möglichst viele Fahrzeuge irgendwie durch die Werkstatt zu bekommen. Uns ist wichtig, dass sauber gearbeitet wird, Probleme wirklich gelöst werden und unsere Kunden ihr Fahrzeug mit einem guten Gefühl wieder abholen. Wir arbeiten an Fahrzeugen aller Marken und decken ein breites Spektrum ab: Inspektionen nach Herstellervorgaben, Diagnose, Bremsen, Motor, Fahrwerk, Klima, Getriebe, Umbauten und vieles mehr. Gerade deshalb ist der Alltag bei uns abwechslungsreich. Kein Tag ist genau wie der andere und wenn ein Fehler nicht sofort auf der Hand liegt, nehmen wir uns die Zeit, ihn wirklich zu finden. Unsere Werkstatt ist modern und sehr gut ausgestattet. Mehrere Hebebühnen, aktuelle Diagnosetechnik und alles, was man braucht, um ordentlich arbeiten zu können. Gleichzeitig legen wir viel Wert darauf, dass die Werkstatt sauber, gepflegt und ein angenehmer Arbeitsplatz ist. Schließlich verbringt man hier einen großen Teil seines Tages und soll sich auch wohlfühlen. Für unser Team suchen wir einen Kfz-Meister (m/w/d) , der sein Handwerk versteht, gerne Verantwortung übernimmt und Lust auf ein Umfeld hat, in dem gute Arbeit geschätzt wird. Was wir dir bieten Bei uns kannst du dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung wirklich einbringen. Du hast die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Entscheidungen mitzutreffen und bei anspruchsvolleren Fällen deine Erfahrung einzusetzen. Du unterstützt unser Team bei Diagnose und Fehlersuche, behältst die Qualität der Arbeiten im Blick und sorgst gemeinsam mit uns dafür, dass die Abläufe in der Werkstatt stimmen. Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Experience Required: 7+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Kafka Engineer to architect, deploy, and operate large-scale Apache Kafka and Confluent platform environments supporting mission-critical event-driven workloads. In this role you will own the Kafka platform end-to-end, including cluster sizing, configuration, security, automation, observability, and developer enablement. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of experience operating Apache Kafka or Confluent Platform in production.

• Deep, hands-on knowledge of Kafka internals (partitions, replication, ISRs, consumer groups).

• Strong experience with Kafka security (SASL, mTLS, ACLs, RBAC).

• Hands-on experience with Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, and either Kafka Streams or ksqlDB.

• Experience with HA/DR strategies for Kafka.

• Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or Go.

• Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible).

• Working knowledge of observability tooling for Kafka.

• Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Confluent Certified Administrator or Developer credentials.

• Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes (Strimzi, Confluent Operator).

• Exposure to managed Kafka services (AWS MSK, Azure Event Hubs Kafka API).

• Familiarity with stream processing frameworks (Flink, Spark Streaming).

• Experience with data governance and lineage for streaming data.

description:
About the Business
LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at

About the Team
The LexisNexis Risk Solutions Product Support Engineering organization is a global, customer-focused team supporting mission-critical financial crime compliance platforms with the world’s top banking and financial institutions as our customers. The team partners closely with Product Experts, Product Tech and other cross-functional teams to protect service reliability, customer confidence, and continuous product improvement in fast-paced, SLA-driven environments.
About the Role
The Enterprise Support Engineer provides advanced technical support and engineering-level investigation into complex customer-reported production issues. The role combines end-to-end support case ownership with deep troubleshooting across the application, container platform, infrastructure, database, network, identity, messaging, storage, integration, and customer-configuration layers.
This is not a scripted triage position. The Enterprise Support Engineer gathers evidence, recreates customer scenarios, reproduces failures, identifies root causes, validates corrections, and communicates clear findings to customers and internal stakeholders. The engineer manages severity, escalations, and SLA commitments.
Responsibilities

• Own assigned customer support cases from intake through resolution, including accurate logging, prioritization, status updates, customer communication, and SLA adherence.

• Analyze application and container logs, platform events, configuration files, environment variables, secrets, data feeds, database records, API responses, deployment artifacts, and system behavior.

• Troubleshoot Kubernetes and OpenShift resources, including pods, deployments, services, ingress or routes, namespaces, ConfigMaps, secrets, persistent volumes, probes, resource limits, image versions, networking, and scaling behavior.

• Diagnose issues spanning Java web applications, REST APIs, databases, messaging middleware, object storage, authentication and SSO, TLS certificates, cloud infrastructure, and customer integrations.

• Distinguish among product defects, environmental issues, configuration errors, resource constraints, data problems, and integration failures using evidence-based root-cause analysis.

• Correlate logs, metrics, events, traces, timestamps, transaction IDs, request IDs, pod names, service names, configuration, and customer-reported symptoms.

• Perform issue reproduction, hypothesis testing, defect validation, and technical troubleshooting activities.

• Collaborate with internal teams and customers to drive issue resolution and continuous service improvement.

Requirements

• Experience supporting, deploying, implementing, or troubleshooting enterprise web applications, preferably Java-based, in production.

• Working knowledge of Linux or Unix and Windows environments, command-line diagnostics, system outputs, and deployment configuration.

• Understanding of client/server and web application concepts, including HTTP/HTTPS, requests and responses, sessions, cookies, headers, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, connectivity, performance, and timeouts.

• Hands-on experience with, or strong working knowledge of, Kubernetes and/or OpenShift, containers, registries, Helm, externalized configuration, persistent storage, service discovery, probes, resource management, and deployment troubleshooting.

• Understanding of public, private, and hybrid cloud architectures,

Our selling methodology only works if it holds when nobody is in the room. Our revenue enablement team makes that happen. One part of the team sets the methodology and coaches sellers directly. • AI as a practical tool: Use AI to speed up drafting, curation, and routine tasks. Test ideas quickly, keep what works, and protect quality while you move fast.

• Cross-team partnership: Work with RevOps, Product Marketing, Product, and Engineering. Bring clear requirements and follow up after each launch, so sellers are ready when a release arrives.

• Prioritization: You will have more requests than time. Prioritize the backlog, sequence the work, and explain your choices to your partners.

What you bring

• Enablement program experience: Proven experience running sales enablement, revenue enablement, or GTM programs from start to finish in B2B technology, including programs that changed a measurable behavior.

• Sales or solutions engineering background: Experience in sales or solutions engineering, with a clear sense of what sellers need in a live deal.

• Builder mindset

title: Product Owner
description:
Welcome to MICE DESK
﻿
MICE DESK is the leading European company automating the sales process in the hospitality industry - and we are now expanding to the US.
Our platform, Rocket , turns event, meeting, and group inquiries into autonomous end-to- end workflows: from RFP to signed contract, across email, CRM, and PMS systems. We integrate with the systems hotels actually run on - Oracle OPERA Cloud, SIHOT, Guestline, Salesforce, Marriott's enterprise stack - which means our engineers work inside real hotel operations, not against sandbox APIs.
We are a Series A-stage company with a deliberately small team and real enterprise traction: major hotel groups across Europe run their group sales on Rocket. The people joining now shape the product, the deployment playbook, and the culture.
﻿
﻿﻿
The Role
Product Owners are how Rocket turns product direction into successful execution. You own specific product domains within the platform, ensuring engineering teams have clear requirements, priorities, and context needed to deliver high-quality features.
This is not a strategy ownership role. You work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, QA, and customer-facing teams to translate product direction into actionable requirements, manage delivery, and ensure successful execution within your product area.
If you enjoy solving complex product problems, coordinating teams, and turning ideas into reliable software experiences, this is the role.
What You Will Own
1. Backlog ownership and delivery execution.
Own delivery for assigned product domains across the MICE DESK platform. Manage and refine the backlog, prioritize work based on guidance from the Product Manager, customer input, and business impact, and ensure engineering teams have everything required to deliver successful features.
2. Requirements and feature definition.
Translate product direction and customer needs into clear, actionable requirements for engineering teams. Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications while ensuring features are well understood before development begins.
3. Cross-functional collaboration.
Act as the connection point between Product, Engineering, Design, QA, and customer-facing teams throughout the development lifecycle. Support alignment on scope, priorities, delivery expectations, and successful feature releases.
4. Customer and product understanding.
Build a strong working understanding of customer workflows and operational pain points within your product domain. Support customer feedback collection, help validate solutions in partnership with the Product Manager, and provide insights that improve product execution.
5. Continuous improvement.
Improve product delivery through structured feedback, better processes, and execution-level insights. Surface opportunities for product enhancements to inform product strategy, support product discovery and experimentation led by the Product Manager, and contribute insights to long-term product planning.
What Success Looks Like

•
3 months: You understand your assigned product domains, work effectively with Engineering and Product, and independently manage requirements, backlog refinement, and delivery processes.

•
12 months: You own delivery across key product areas, engineering teams rely on your clarity and execution, and your work consistently improves feature delivery quality and customer outcomes.

﻿

﻿

Who You Are
Must-have
﻿

• 4+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, or similar role in a SaaS or software product environment

• Proven experience managing product backlogs and supporting software delivery

• Strong ability to translate customer and product needs into clear requirements

• Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications

• Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies

• Experience working closely with engineering teams throughout the software development lifecy

About the job

Lead the team making high-speed connections and power delivery reliable across Graphcore’s AI compute hardware.

You’ll help specialists shape requirements, design margins and acceptance criteria across silicon, package, PCB and system boundaries. Your team’s constraints and verification evidence will help design owners make informed trade-offs before problems become harder to resolve.

You’ll line-manage engineers, shape their development, agree achievable delivery commitments, and plan for tools, licences and compute capacity. You’ll coordinate analysis and hardware correlation, ensuring discrepancies receive specialist attention and integrity issues reach review and closure.

The methods and knowledge your team builds will outlast individual designs, strengthening how Graphcore approaches future signal and power challenges. Grow your leadership across interconnected engineering disciplines, combining people development with judgement that influences hardware from architecture to bring-up.

The team and culture

Signal and power integrity specialists retain technical ownership, rather than relying on one person to solve every problem. You’ll connect their work with design, firmware, test, bring-up and manufacturing colleagues.

Programme management owns the integrated plan. You’ll raise capacity conflicts early, bring practical options and make delivery confidence visible.

Decisions depend on evidence, documented assumptions and proportionate peer review. You’ll encourage challenge, seek specialist input when needed and escalate unresolved disagreements before they hold work back.

What we’re looking for

• People leadership that develops engineers, sets expectations and addresses difficult performance issues, with readiness for formal line management.

• Strong engineering foundations and experience in signal or power integrity, with sufficient understanding of the other discipline to challenge approaches.

• Experience coordinating specialist engineering delivery, including estimates, work allocation, dependencies and capacity, in partnership with programme management.

• Clear cross-disciplinary communication that explains risks and trade-offs, secures specialist contributions and helps stakeholders reach decisions.

• First-principles reasoning and understanding of simulation, measurement and correlation, including model limitations and when to seek specialist review.

Job Title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - Jefferson City
Job Location: Work at Home, Missouri, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Per diem employees qualify for:

• Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

•
Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.

•
Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.

•
Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.

•
Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.

•
Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.

•
Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.

•
Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.

•
Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

title: Compute & Infrastructure Accounting
description:
About the Team

OpenAI Finance is responsible for ensuring the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission. The Compute & Infrastructure team shares financial insights and partners with internal and external business stakeholders to manage the accounting and financial reporting for OpenAI’s rapidly evolving infrastructure investments.

The team supports a broad and increasingly complex portfolio of compute and infrastructure arrangements, including cloud computing, data centers, servers, equipment, rack financing, colocation arrangements, and other AI infrastructure deployments. We are responsible for ensuring financial accuracy, operational scalability, and informed decision-making as OpenAI continues to invest in advanced technologies and expand its infrastructure footprint.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and technically skilled accounting professional to manage the accounting and financial reporting for OpenAI’s compute and infrastructure lease-related activities. In this role, you will own complex lease accounting matters across data centers, servers, equipment, and other infrastructure arrangements, while helping operationalize new programs as the organization continues to scale.

You will evaluate unique and highly structured transactions, assess their accounting implications, and translate technical conclusions into clear recommendations for leadership. You will also work cross-functionally to design the processes, systems, controls, and data solutions required to support accurate and scalable accounting operations.

This role requires a strong command of US GAAP, particularly lease accounting and consolidation, as well as the ability to operate effectively and fluidly in an evolving environment where new infrastructure programs may not yet have established processes or system solutions. The ideal candidate is both a technical accounting expert and a hands-on builder who can turn complex arrangements into sustainable operating models.

You will partner closely with Finance, Technical Accounting, Legal, Tax, Procurement, Engineering, Infrastructure, and other key stakeholders. You will also work with external counterparties and service providers to ensure the accounting treatment, operational processes, and reporting outputs are accurate, well-documented, and scalable.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

 

In this role, you will:

- Own the end-to-end accounting for compute and infrastructure lease-related activities, including data centers, servers, equipment, colocation arrangements, and other infrastructure deployments.

- Evaluate new and evolving infrastructure arrangements to determine the appropriate accounting treatment under US GAAP, including lease identification, classification, measurement, commencement, modification, impairment, and presentation considerations.

- Partner with Technical Accounting and other cross-functional stakeholders to assess complex or non-standard transactions, document accounting conclusions, and present the financial reporting implications to senior leadership.

- Lead the accounting operationalization of new compute and infrastructure programs by developing scalable processes, controls, systems, data requirements, and reporting solutions from the ground up.

- Design and implement system solutions to support lease accounting, fixed asset tracking, subledger requirements, data integration, and management reporting.

- Own month-end and quarter-end close activities for the lease portfolio, including journal entries, reconciliations, flux analysis, rollforwards, balance sheet substantiation, and reporting packages.

- Ensure the completeness and accuracy of lease-related accounting records by developing robust contract intake, asset tracking, and reconciliation processes.

description:
Job Description Summary
As Sr Global Product Manager, Digital Solutions - Surgical & Procedural Care, you will shape the strategy, roadmap, and growth of digital solutions supporting perioperative workflows across pre-operative, intraoperative, and post-operative care. Working across executive leadership, product management, engineering, commercial, and functional teams, you will define portfolio-aligned priorities and deliver solutions that aim to improve clinical decision making, workflow efficiency, care coordination, and operational outcomes across the perioperative continuum. In partnership with customers, key opinion leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will advance the vision of precision health.

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. Job Description
Essential Responsibilities:
You will engage key external and internal stakeholders to define product strategy, build business and investment cases, and lead the successful development and commercialization of digital solutions. You will translate customer and market needs into differentiated products, prioritize investments, and partner with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions through agile development processes. You will align roadmaps with portfolio strategy, investment guardrails, and enterprise objectives. You will own the full product lifecycle and be accountable for the commercial success of perioperative digital solutions, driving customer adoption, recurring revenue growth, and measurable business outcomes. You will engage directly with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders to shape market direction and portfolio growth.
In this role you will:

• Own strategy and execution for digital applications in the perioperative workflow, including analytics, surveillance, and decision-support solutions that aim to improve care-team efficiency and clinical outcomes.

• Drive profitable growth of application domain through effective product strategy, execution, commercialization, and lifecycle management.

• Own application strategy, business cases, and outcome-based roadmaps by translating customer needs, market opportunities, and competitive insights into differentiated products.

• Own the commercial success of NPIs, including launch readiness, customer adoption, revenue growth, market penetration, and achievement of business case objectives.

• Define product vision, value proposition, success metrics, and priorities, and lead execution across the product lifecycle from concept through delivery, commercialization, and adoption.

• Develop and execute commercialization, go-to-market, and growth strategies in partnership with marketing, commercial, and service teams.

• Influence pricing, packaging, business model, and investment decisions to maximize customer value, competitive differentiation, and long-term growth.

• Build strong relationships with customers, Key Opinion Leaders, and partners, and serve as the domain expert and external spokesperson for application domain.

• Drive adoption, retention, customer value realization, and recurring revenue growth across the installed base.

Critical Competencies & Skills:

• Perioperative Clinical Workflow Expertise - Understanding of anesthesia, perioperative workflow, care-team coordination, and clinical decision-support needs across surgical and procedural care environments.

• Strategic Product Leadership & Commercial Acumen - Ability to develop product strategies, business cases, and investment recommendations linked to customer and business outcomes.

• Product Development & Execution - Experience leading products through the lifecycle from concept through commercialization, adoption, and growth.
